title: Evaluate Visual Design Quality Gate Prompt
task: In a fictional engineering repository, for a template card grid, inspect hierarchy, token use, long titles, focus and selected states, empty results, 390-pixel layout, and spacing consistency before accepting polish.
acceptance_criteria: Viewport screenshots or live observations with exact component and state locations for each finding.
Computed token, typography, spacing, colour, and state evidence for deviations from the design system.
Before-and-after comparison using realistic content at the same viewport and rendering conditions.
Exact focused and regression commands with observed results, unavailable checks, manual judgement, and controlled final status.
failure_signals: Reject aesthetic findings without a concrete hierarchy, readability, consistency, or interaction consequence.
Reject visual acceptance based on one idealized viewport and short fixture content.
